{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && PYTHONPATH=src:. python -c "
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter
from copy import deepcopy
import copy

# Test R01: basic apply
print('=== R01: Basic apply ===')
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)
assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]) == [1]
assert db.all()[0]['x'] == 1
assert w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}]) == []
assert len(db) == 0

# Test empty input
assert w.apply([]) == []
print('R01 OK')

# Test R01: ValueError on unknown/malformed
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'unknown'}])
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': 'not a dict'}])
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass
print('R01 ValueError OK')

# Test R02: Atomic rollback
print('=== R02: Atomic rollback ===')
db.insert({'x': 1})
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass
assert [v['x'] for v in db.all()] == [1]
print('R02 OK')

# Test R04: Reject bool as doc_id
print('=== R04: Bool rejection ===')
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': True}])
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}])
except ValueError:
    assert False, 'Empty dict should be accepted'
print('R04 OK')

# Test R05: Preview doesn't consume IDs
print('=== R05: Preview ===')
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w2 = BatchWriter(db2)
assert w2.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
assert len(db2) == 0
assert w2.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
assert len(db2) == 0
assert w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]
assert len(db2) == 1
print('R05 OK')

# Test R07: Idempotent token
print('=== R07: Idempotent token ===')
db3 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w3 = BatchWriter(db3)
ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
assert w3.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]
assert w3.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]
assert len(db3) == 1
try:
    w3.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}], token='a')
    assert False, 'Should have raised'
except ValueError:
    pass
assert len(db3) == 1
print('R07 OK')

# Test R06: Direct inserts seen by wrapper
print('=== R06: Direct inserts ===')
db4 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w4 = BatchWriter(db4)
db4.insert({'x': 1})
assert w4.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [2]
print('R06 OK')

# Test no aliasing
print('=== No aliasing ===')
db5 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w5 = BatchWriter(db5)
input_doc = {'nested': {'a': 1}}
result = w5.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': input_doc}])
input_doc['nested']['a'] = 999
stored = db5.get(result[0])
assert stored['nested']['a'] == 1, f'Aliasing detected: {stored}'
print('No aliasing OK')

print('\nAll tests passed!')
